audit_scope.name: audit_scope
audit_scope.value:
("audit_events"."church_id" IS NOT NULL AND "audit_events"."tenant" IS NULL AND "audit_events"."action" NOT IN ('admin.bootstrapped','admin.granted','admin.revoked','feature_flag.all','feature_flag.selected','feature_flag.disabled')) OR ("audit_events"."church_id" IS NULL AND (("audit_events"."tenant" IS NULL) = ("audit_events"."action" IN (
        'admin.bootstrapped', 'admin.granted', 'admin.revoked',
        'feature_flag.all', 'feature_flag.selected', 'feature_flag.disabled'
      ))))

invitation_terminal.name: invitation_terminal
invitation_terminal.value: ("church_invitations"."accepted_at" IS NULL OR "church_invitations"."cancelled_at" IS NULL) AND (("church_invitations"."accepted_at" IS NULL) = ("church_invitations"."accepted_by" IS NULL)) AND (("church_invitations"."cancelled_at" IS NULL) = ("church_invitations"."cancelled_by" IS NULL))
